dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250918-GNB-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250918-GNB-01) A flood occurred on Sep 18 2025 in Guinea-Bissau. It affected an estimated 26367 people and 3032 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
